lines.name: title
lines.text: A customer's phone number vanished somewhere between Salesforce and the CRM.

lines.name: search
lines.text: Start with the account's Salesforce ID.

lines.name: results
lines.text: Two journeys come back for this account. One completed, and one failed.

lines.name: timeline
lines.text: Here is every step, across two services. Delivery to the CRM failed, was retried twice, then dead-lettered.

lines.name: open-transform
lines.text: But delivery isn't where it broke. Open the transform step.

lines.name: diff
lines.text: This is the payload before and after the step, field by field.

lines.name: diff-phone
lines.text: The phone goes in with a value, and comes out null. This is the step that lost it.

lines.name: good
lines.text: Now the journey that completed, for contrast.

lines.name: good-phone
lines.text: Its payload carried the field the transform reads, so the phone kept its value.

lines.name: replay-link
lines.text: Back on the failed journey, replay the step's recorded input.

lines.name: replay-form
lines.text: It goes to a development destination running the fix, not to the original system.

lines.name: replay-response
lines.text: The fixed transform answers with a 200.

lines.name: replay-diff
lines.text: Original against replay. The phone was null, and now it's back.
